'''K3-F7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
K3-F7 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Imperial Flashpoint courier for the [[Korriban Incursion]] Flashpoint, though he is only found aboard Vaiken Spacedock and not on other planets like other couriers.<ref name="TOR" />
